scope: Repository-only investigation of nine assigned properties; no Antithesis or native campaign executed

questions.old_question: Which external response header or event proves a cache hit without asking Brady's store to self-attest?
questions.answer: No dedicated response hit header. With one stable unique key and no concurrent requester, unchanged origin request count plus complete client bytes is the independent hit witness; brady.request_completed cache=:hit is supporting telemetry.

questions.old_question: Can the hosted filesystem/fault setup offer a true persisted power-cut boundary, or only process kills?
questions.probe: Build a faultable guest storage boundary, kill power after object rename, reboot and verify indexed object and bytes. Current commit syncs body and metadata but has no destination-parent directory sync after rename; process kills alone cannot prove power-loss durability.

proposed_catalog_edits: Remove the hit-signal question and specify origin request count as independent oracle.
Keep power-cut question partial and scope the planned Always assertion to process/restart publication until disk power-cut evidence exists.

questions.old_question: Can the hosted TCG router expose independent pool and guest-parent snapshots at each append?
questions.answer: The existing Brady storage Nix VM has real ZFS pool and guest-parent observations. Compare each append to its accepted native sample, freshness deadline, quota and pending reservations; the sample can be up to three seconds old, so do not claim instantaneous free bytes against unrelated writers.

questions.old_question: Which native fault yields uncertain temporary deletion without corrupting the whole pool?
questions.probe: Fault removal of one owned temporary path while leaving the ZFS mount writable; observe retained pending reservation and write pause, then reconcile after repair. Validate that the injector does not also break pressure or all cache writes.

proposed_catalog_edits: State the sample/deadline accounting invariant instead of an instantaneous physical-free-space invariant.
Keep targeted uncertain-delete injection as a partial probe.

questions.old_question: Which TCG router fixture can produce transparent connections and inspect socket inodes without interfering with the accepted backlog?
questions.answer: nix/verification/tests/machines/brady-network runs packaged transparent Brady behind Lilly nftables with veth guest and origin namespaces. Hold guest sockets there; inventory handed-off worker socket inodes separately from backlog sockets. The production release fixes each scheme at 256 workers.

questions.old_question: What measured quiet interval is appropriate for freed-slot progress?
questions.probe: Measure healthy saturation-to-successor latency in the same hosted topology at 256 held sockets; choose a generous bounded tail from those observations and label it a test interval, not a product SLA.

proposed_catalog_edits: Name brady-network as the native transparent fixture and distinguish worker sockets from accept backlog.
Treat limits 1 and 2 as component invocations; packaged configuration has no max_connections override.

questions.old_question: How can the test fill 1025 completed receipts cheaply while preserving a real native Git effect per sampled attempt?
questions.probe: Use generated Manager histories with controlled Git replies for cheap 1023/1024/1025 cap behavior; separately sample real Git against the existing loopback verified-TLS github.com fixture. A combined 1025 real-fetch campaign is feasible with a tiny repo but needs a measured run budget before claiming it.

questions.old_question: Which Marshall status path is authoritative after Enrico receipt eviction or restart?
questions.answer: Marshall's locked PostgreSQL repository attempt is durable authority. Enrico missing status for a refreshing/failed attempt causes a new attempt ID and service_unavailable abandonment; transient transport status failure resumes the old ID. Native fetch may repeat after local receipt loss, so deduplication applies only to retained receipts.

proposed_catalog_edits: Constrain the no-second-fetch assertion to the active/retained Manager receipt window.
Describe missing-after-eviction as a new durable Marshall attempt, not exactly-once native Git execution.

questions.old_question: How can real Git pause after slot acquisition without changing production ownership or executable path?
questions.answer: The native owner takes the global slot and repository flock before execing Git. Existing packaged test pauses the local verified-TLS nginx origin with SIGSTOP, leaving Git blocked after lock acquisition on the production executable path.

questions.old_question: Does hosted Linux preserve inherited-FD and descendant custody with observable locks?
questions.probe: In the chosen hosted image, hold native Git, kill Manager/helper, inventory lock inode holders through /proc/<pid>/fd and /proc/locks, then attempt the ninth command and same-repo command. Source and existing native tests establish implementation, not this hosted observation.

questions.old_question: Can a local deterministic fixture satisfy Enrico's fixed source-origin policy without weakening it?
questions.answer: Existing Nix machine resolves the fixed github.com name to a local bare Git HTTPS fixture with a trusted test CA. Enrico still constructs only its hard-coded GitHub URL from validated labels.

proposed_catalog_edits: Use the fixed-origin DNS/TLS fixture and nginx pause as the candidate workload.
Keep hosted inherited-lock observation open until executed; do not infer it from BEAM task counters.

questions.old_question: What safe hook can interrupt real Git between atomic fetch and retained-ref update?
questions.probe: Observe native command exec boundaries without replacing Git, for example trace execve of symbolic-ref/update-ref after fetch, then kill and read prior published SHA via git cat-file. Validate the trigger and old-SHA oracle in the hosted image before claiming this exact window.

questions.old_question: How can a deterministic local Git fixture preserve Enrico's fixed production source-origin boundary?
questions.answer: Reuse the existing packaged verified HTTPS fixture that maps fixed github.com to loopback, force-pushes a bare repo, prunes Git, and checks an older explicit SHA remains browsable.

proposed_catalog_edits: Keep the property on explicit durable Marshall SHA and unchanged tree/blob bytes, not mutable HEAD.
Mark exact post-fetch interruption as a prospective probe while retaining broad process/source-outage histories.

questions.old_question: Which current-credential fixture isolates one owner/day/provider/model bucket?
questions.probe: Compose real Marshall/PostgreSQL with a dedicated owner/VM/host and rotated current Ziggy host credential as in Marshall requests_test; baseline the exact Daily key and quiesce other writers. Existing packaged Ziggy machine uses synthetic Control and cannot prove Marshall aggregate conservation.

questions.old_question: How can an observer sample spool removal after directory sync/recovery settles?
questions.answer: After exact Marshall ACK and Spool.acknowledge return, wait for no slot file, restart Ziggy and verify no recovered slot; the removal path syncs the directory before dropping the in-memory entry. This proves process-restart scope; power-cut persistence needs a separate faultable disk.

proposed_catalog_edits: Specify the exact isolated Daily bucket and real Marshall credential requirement for the aggregate oracle.
Scope settled slot removal to ACK, directory sync, and process restart; keep physical power-cut durability separate.

questions.old_question: Which safe HTTP/agent fixture correlation observes effects without changing production payload semantics?
questions.answer: Ziggy does not forward its internal request ID upstream. For a controlled single outstanding call or claim, use a unique synthetic marker in the ordinary legal request body and a private fixture ledger of provider accepts; compare count before and after recovery. Keep marker and payload out of Ziggy diagnostics. Concurrent calls require separate private fixture correlation.

proposed_catalog_edits: Name the one-outstanding-call fixture scope and independent provider accept ledger.
Do not claim provider-side exactly-once semantics or identify effects solely from Ziggy request IDs.

questions.old_question: Which HTTP/agent routes share a spool in the chosen deployment?
questions.answer: One Ziggy release starts one named Spool using config.spool; both HTTP inference and enabled AgentWorker call it before Upstream.stream. Distinct Ziggy hosts use distinct spool directories.

questions.old_question: Can hosted faults expose directory-sync uncertainty beyond process restart?
questions.probe: Inject a targeted directory fsync error after a slot file write and verify failed admission fences provider effects; use a faultable disk/power-cut boundary for persistence claims. Existing packaged fixture exercises SIGKILL/restart and full spool, not fsync failure.

proposed_catalog_edits: State that HTTP and agent share only their local Ziggy Spool, with maxPendingRequests=8 in the existing packaged fixture.
Keep directory-sync uncertainty as a separate unexecuted fault probe.
